lines.text: Before starting another budget, check whether the problem is stale data, too much upkeep, missing bills or income that does not cover the essentials.

items.text: Check when balances and transactions were last updated.
List essential payments due before the next reliable income, including non-monthly bills and known commitments.
Identify the maintenance job you stopped doing: imports, category decisions, manual entry, reconciliation or something else.

eyebrow.text: Before moving to another budgeting app

items.text: Check export, deletion, data access and saving arrangements.
Confirm whether imports or connections are supported and what requires manual checking.
Choose a review routine that fits your actual responsibilities.

line.text: Because they need daily upkeep. This one has a short weekly check-in and a quiet way back in when you have been away for weeks.
